changelog:
- Initial release of OpenClaw TWA (Telegram Mini App) Deployer.
- Lets users deploy interactive HTML answers to Vercel and share them via Telegram inline buttons (TWA) from the OpenClaw bot.
- Guides users through Vercel account/token setup and provides step-by-step deployment and messaging instructions.
- Enforces UI and coding conventions: dark theme, client-side single-file HTML, Telegram WebApp SDK, and responsive/mobile design.
- Includes rules, troubleshooting tips, and sample API commands for deployment and Telegram integration.
summary: Deploy interactive Telegram Mini App (TWA) answers from OpenClaw. Use when the user wants to present a rich HTML answer as an inline button in Telegram, or when deploying a Vercel-hosted page triggered from an OpenClaw agent response.
